name: open-core
description: open-core — lõi chạy của Bizcity Open (@bizcity/platform, @bizcity/contracts, @bizcity/server…): một nguồn, mọi gói chung một số phiên bản. GPL-2.0-or-later.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bizcity/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @bizcity/platform run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @bizcity/platform run typecheck
scripts.test: node tools/kiem-khung.mjs && pnpm run build && tsc -p packages/platform/test/types && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "packages/platform/test/*.test.mjs"
